title: Social Media Video Editor & Designer
full_text: Description Company overview CapsLock specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges. Our services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, ensuring efficient and accelerated growth. Founded by industry professionals in IT, design, and data analytics, we address the market need for exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock , we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry-leading services and customer experiences. ﻿Role overview The Social Media Video Editor & Designer at CapsLock creates engaging, platform-first video content for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook. The role is primarily focused on short-form video editing — turning raw footage into polished, dynamic videos through strong pacing, storytelling, transitions, captions, sound, and motion graphics. It also calls for solid graphic design skills to produce supporting static assets such as graphics, thumbnails, overlays, and other visual elements when needed. Working closely with the social media team, this person keeps content aligned with brand guidelines, marketing objectives, and platform best practices — while staying on top of new editing styles, creative formats, and social media trends. Responsibilities Video Editing & Post-Production Edit engaging short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, with a focus on strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, and platform-native formats. Turn raw footage into polished social content using cuts, captions, transitions, music, voiceovers, sound effects, and visual effects. Adapt and optimize content for different platforms, formats, aspect ratios, and technical requirements. Graphic Design & Creative Development Create motion graphics and supporting design assets, including overlays, text animations, thumbnails, static posts, and Stories. Develop creative concepts and video drafts, incorporating team and stakeholder feedback into final deliverables. Collaboration & Performance Collaborate with the social media team to review performance and improve creatives based on engagement, retention, and other key metrics. Work cross-functionally with CRO, Media Buying, Sales, and other teams to support campaign and business objectives. Trends & Workflow Management Stay current with social media trends, editing styles, platform updates, and emerging creative formats. Maintain organized project files and digital assets with clear version control. Requirements 3+ years of professional video editing and creative experience, ideally focused on social media and digital content. Strong portfolio showcasing short-form video editing, motion graphics, and graphic design work. Strong video editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools. Graphic design skills using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar tools. Strong visual storytelling skills, with a good understanding of pacing, hooks, composition, and attention to detail. Solid understanding of TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, including current content formats, trends, and creative best practices. Ability to follow brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas to content. Results-driven mindset, with an understanding of how creative decisions can impact engagement and performance. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment. Nice-to-Have Requirements Experience with motion graphics, animation, or advanced visual effects. Experience creating content for influencer campaigns, UGC, or branded collaborations. Familiarity with AI-powered video, design, and content creation tools. Understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and engagement strategies. Background in digital marketing or performance-driven creative, with an understanding of how video content contributes to engagement, clicks, and conversions. What we offer Flexible Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from any comfortable location within the CET time zone, allowing you to create your ideal work environment. Competitive compensation package. Benefit from a highly competitive salary, reflective of your expertise and leadership skills in the design and marketing fields. Work-Life balance: Full-time employment with a flexible schedule to accommodate your personal needs Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge Emphasis on maintaining a healthy work-life balance Comprehensive benefits: Attractive benefits package to support your health and well-being Performance-based bonus system to reward your contributions Professional growth: Collaborate with a highly skilled and professional team Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement Unique work culture: Join a diverse, international team that values innovation, creativity, and collaboration. Experience a work environment where your ideas and leadership can truly make an impact. Originally posted on Himalayas

Defining comprehensive requirements for resource & financial dashboards tailored to the specific needs of program managers, product teams, and leadership. Work closely with the BI development team to ensure these dashboards are built to specification, providing intuitive, data-rich visualizations that enable informed decision-making at all levels. Facilitating the process to ensure that critical operational and financial data is readily accessible and easily interpretable, supporting strategic planning and day-to-day management across the organization. Building and maintaining dashboards for operational KPIs including product adoption, user engagement, platform performance, and accuracy metrics Communication & Information Mgt: Build and present clear and concise presentations that include data visualizations, dashboards, strategic level directions, etc. Maintaining centralized SharePoint site serving as single source of truth for I&D team operations, product documentation, and strategic planning materials Organizing & publishing key info including product roadmaps, sprint calendars, metrics dashboards, team updates, new hire spotlights, and recognition programs Assist in driving operational portfolio performance through effective resource allocation and continuous monitoring of KPIs. Pilot automations in a controlled way, measure time/error savings, & iterate before wider rollout. Maintain documentation on what's automated, how it works, & ownership. title: Customer Success Manager, Scale
full_text: You've helped run a scale or pooled CS model before, or you've been inside one long enough to know what works and what doesn't. You know that scale CS done badly is just support with a fancier title, and done well it's a system that delivers consistent value to hundreds of customers. You want to join and help build the good version. Expel is an MDR company. Our customers are security teams who depend on us to find and stop threats. We're launching a scale model for a segment of our customer base, and we're building it from scratch: the playbooks, the automation, the operating model, the measurement framework. You won't inherit a finished system. You'll be a primary contributor to designing it. That means you're not just executing motions. You own specific programs within the model (new customer/onboarding cohorts, renewal campaigns, segment outreach), you exercise judgment on the edge cases the playbook doesn't cover, and you identify patterns across hundreds of customer interactions that tell you where the model needs to improve. When something breaks, you fix the process, not just the situation. Your success is measured by the team's retention outcomes across the scale segment, the quality of your execution, and the motions you build and improve. What Expel can do for you Put you at the center of building a scale CS model from scratch inside a security company, with the latitude to shape how it works Give you a company transforming security operations from industry-leading 20-minute outcomes toward 20-second outcomes with AI and automation, the kind of product story that makes CS conversations genuinely interesting Surround you with experienced CS leadership that has built scale models before and knows the difference between good and bad Connect you with customers who genuinely care about their security programs Offer a clear path to grow professionally as our scale program and company grow What you can do for Expel Help design, execute and continuously improve playbook-driven customer interactions across the scale process execution and customer handling Contribute to the design of the scale operating model itself: systems requirements, automation workflows, measurement frameworks What you should bring with you creativity, and what needs escalation Solid security domain fluency: MDR, EDR, SIEM, NDR, cloud security, and how a real security program fits together Familiarity with CS platforms, ticketing systems, and automation tools, with opinions about what works Additional notes The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 and $136,200 + bonus eligibility and equity. title: Penetration Testing Analyst
full_text: About Us Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats. Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at . Role Summary Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Penetration Testing Analyst 3 to join our Red Team. The Sophos Red Team is engaged by organizations worldwide to identify and exploit vulnerabilities within client environments, applying information security threat intelligence to uncover the same weaknesses real-world adversaries would target. Responsible for escalating issues to management and taking ownership of new challenges to add value. Candidates are not expected to be experienced in both focus areas, although that would be a plus. You will excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team, performing other essential duties as assigned. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close. Strong discovery, consultative selling, commercial negotiation, presentation and deal-orchestration skills. title: Payroll Specialist
full_text: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers. Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact. Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process. This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy. Responsibilities Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries Requirements 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work Benefits Salary: £35,000 - £45,000 Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho) Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. title: Senior Software Engineer - REDAPL Graph Engine
full_text:
Please note that the job is only available from the locations outlined. 

 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us take REDAPL, our Referential Data Platform, to the next level. REDAPL is Datadog's main platform for tracking our customers' infrastructure resources and relationships. The platform enables products where customers can understand, keep track of, and gain insights into their infrastructure related to performance, cost, security, and more.

Many Datadog products use REDAPL today such Cloud Security Posture Management, Resource Catalog, Cloud Cost Management, and Service Catalog and others - REDAPL ingests more than 4.5mil updates/second.

As a Senior Engineer, you will drive, lead and collaborate on projects both inside and outside the platform. You can expect to contribute to key technical decisions relating to our data ingestion, processing, and query pipelines.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Build a query engine that supports efficient relationship traversals for our most demanding workloads.
  • Contribute to design and drive high-priority, high-visibility projects to increase the platform's value, resilience, and scalability across multiple teams.
  • Lead and guide other engineers through architectural platform decisions
  • Identify potential system risks and trends in reliability and design solutions to address them
  • Provide input on prioritizing engineering-led initiatives in short- and long-term planning and roadmaps
  • Collaborate with internal product teams to understand their requirements and how we plan for their product growth as they integrate and depend on REDAPL

 

Who You Are:

  • You have a BS/MS/PhD in a Computer Science, Engineering or related scientific field or equivalent experience
  • You have worked extensively with multiple types of data stores. 
  • You have contributed to initiatives in a platform or infrastructure-focused environment for several years
  • You have led impactful technical initiatives in an environment where performance, cost efficiency, ease of use, and resilience/operability are first-order concerns
  • You have significant back-end engineering experience and have built, and operated distributed systems to solve problems at a high scale

Bonus points:

  • You have experience working with Graph Databases such as Neo4j, Memgraph, JanusGraph, ArangoDB, Amazon Neptune or PuppyGraph.
  • You have production-grade experience with Apache Iceberg
  • You have a solid grasp of query planning or better yet - contributed to a production-grade query engines or related projects (e.g. Trino, Calcite, Substrait, DataFusion, etc) ideally demonstrated through open-source contributions or PMC membership on projects.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Get to build tools for software engineers, just like yourself. And use the tools we build to accelerate our development.
  • Have a lot of influence on product direction and impact on the business .
  • Work with skilled, knowledgeable, and kind teammates who are happy to teach and learn
  • Competitive global benefits
  • Continuous professional development

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Director of Sales, Europe
full_text:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

Based in London, the Director NATO & Nordics will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.
  • Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.
  • Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.
  • Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.
  • Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
  • Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.
  • Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.
  • Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.
  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.
  • Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).
  • Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).
  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

title: Account Executive at PartsBase Inc.

Showcase Value : Conduct compelling virtual presentations to demonstrate how PartsBase improves procurement processes and drives growth. Promote Advertising Opportunities : Educate prospects about advertising on the PartsBase platform and at PBExpo , emphasizing ROI and brand exposure. Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Work closely with marketing, customer success, and product teams to align sales strategies with business goals and share market insights. Continuously Learn : Stay up-to-date on industry trends, prospect feedback, and product developments to refine your approach and deepen your expertise. Self-motivated and results-driven, with a passion for helping businesses grow. Adaptable, coachable, and eager to continuously learn. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Offered Medical benefits to keep you healthy and secure. Paid time off to recharge and enjoy life outside of work. Competitive base salary + lucrative commissions. Comprehensive training to ensure you’re set up for success. Clear career growth paths and development opportunities. Be part of a fast-growing, innovative company that’s shaping the future of aviation commerce. Why Join PartsBase? At PartsBase, you’re not just joining another sales team, you’re joining a company that has spent 30+ years revolutionizing the aerospace and defense industry through cutting-edge technology, powerful data intelligence, and the world’s leading aviation marketplace. Every conversation you have and every relationship you build helps aviation and defense organizations around the globe operate more efficiently and make smarter decisions. What’s In It For You? • Accelerate Your Career – Learn from experienced sales leaders who are invested in your growth and success. • Make a Real Impact – Sell industry-leading solutions that support some of the world’s most important aerospace and defense organizations. • Win as a Team – Join a high-energy, collaborative culture where achievements are celebrated and success is shared. • Work Remote, Forever – Enjoy the flexibility of being part of a fully remote company. Remote work isn’t a temporary perk—it’s a core part of who we are and will remain a permanent part of our culture. • Work with Innovation – Gain exposure to cutting-edge technology, AI-driven tools, and one of the largest aviation data platforms in the world. • Grow with a Market Leader – Build your career at a company trusted by aviation professionals worldwide for more than three decades. Enjoy More of Your Weekend! We value work-life balance, which is why our team wraps up one hour early every Friday to get a head start on the weekend. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Get an inside look at our culture, people, and benefits–Check us out here: 👉 https://whyworkforpartsbase.netlify.app Our Interview Process We believe applying for a new opportunity should be exciting, not stressful. That’s why we’ve created a transparent, candidate-friendly hiring experience with clear expectations and timely communication every step of the way. ✅ Step 1: Recruiter Introduction Within 48-72 hours of reviewing your application, a recruiter will reach out to schedule an interview and learn more about your background, career goals, and interest in PartsBase. ✅ Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview Next, you’ll meet with the Hiring Manager to discuss the day-to-day responsibilities, team culture, performance expectations, and what success looks like in the Account Executive role. ✅ Step 3: Mock Sales Pitch Ready to show us your sales skills? title: Clinical Sales Exec - East at Butterfly Network, Inc.
full_text: Clinical Sales, Executive Nursing (East) Company Description Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world’s first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative. In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company’s Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly’s proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly’s innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME’s Best Inventions and Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas, among other achievements. We’re a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let’s build something extraordinary together! Job Description Reporting to our Director, Enterprise Sales (East, Central, or West), the Clinical Sales Executive, Nursing is a quota-carrying sales role responsible for closing new business and driving adoption of Butterfly’s point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) platform among nursing teams in hospitals and health systems. You will bring firsthand nursing experience to the sales process, using your clinical credibility with nurse end-users and nursing leadership to build a pipeline, run the full sales cycle, and win new customers within your assigned region. In this role, you will: Establish and maintain credibility with nurses, nurse executives, clinical leaders, educators, professional associations, and healthcare organizations. Represent the company at major nursing and healthcare conferences, association meetings, roundtables, and industry events. Build relationships with influential nursing leaders and develop a network of clinical champions. Monitor emerging trends in nursing practice, workforce challenges, clinical technology, care delivery, and healthcare policy. Bring the voice of the nursing community back into the company to inform product, marketing, sales, and strategy. Participate in professional organizations and cultivate relationships with national and regional nursing associations. Pursue opportunities to speak, moderate panels, participate in advisory boards, write thought-leadership content, and contribute to industry discussions. Own and consistently deliver against an individual sales quota for your assigned region (East, Central, or West), including new-logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts. Build and manage a pipeline of nursing and hospital prospects, and lead deals from initial engagement through negotiation and close. Serve as the clinical and product expert to nursing audiences, delivering hands-on demonstrations of Butterfly’s POCUS platform for bladder scanning and vascular access applications that translate clinical value into a compelling business case. Partner with the Director, Enterprise Sales, Regional Vice Presidents, and account teams to identify, engage, and close nursing stakeholders and decision-makers throughout the sales cycle. Build trusted relationships with bedside nurses, nursing leadership, and clinical education teams to drive product evaluation, trials, and purchasing decisions. Provide accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting, and deliver field and competitive feedback to sales, marketing, and product teams. Travel up to 75% within your assigned region (East, Central, or West) to support demonstrations, trials, and customer relationships. Qualifications Baseline skills/experiences/attributes: Registered Nurse (RN) with an active, unrestricted nursing license and an RN degree (ADN, BSN, or higher). Practicing as an RN, in a clinical bedside or clinical education setting, within the past 5 years. Proven track record of carrying and consistently meeting or exceeding a sales quota, closing new business, and winning new customers. Comfortable presenting to and building rapport with nursing and clinical audiences, including hands-on product demonstrations that lead to a sale. Strong communication, negotiation, and consultative selling skills, with the ability to manage a full sales cycle independently. Willingness and ability to travel up to 75% within your assigned region. Based near a major airport hub within your assigned region (East, Central, or West). Ideally, you also have these skills/experiences/attributes (but it’s ok if you don’t!): Currently practicing as an RN in a clinical setting, even in a limited or per-diem capacity. Hands-on clinical experience performing bladder scans and/or vascular access ultrasound-guided placement. Prior experience in medical device or capital equipment sales, particularly selling into hospital or nursing departments. Values Innovation is what we do. Our values are how we make it happen. Butterflies are and believe in… Patient-Centric Innovators: Our mission is THE mission. Empowered to Impact: Every voice matters. One Team, One Goal: Unity fuels progress. Growth Champions: We embrace challenges. Action-Oriented Achievers: We follow through, every time. Location Butterfly offers a hybrid work model for most positions, with team members spending two or more days a week in the office. While flexibility is key, we value in-person connections that spark creativity and teamwork. Our offices are designed for collaboration, with comfortable workspaces, stocked kitchens, and opportunities to connect with peers. We are hiring for three positions. One for Central, One for East, One for West. This role is remote with up to 75% travel required. East: Located near a major airport in NYC, Boston, or Atlanta Central: Located near a major airport in Chicago, DFW, or Houston West: Located near a major airport in Denver, SF, LA or Seattle (Please note we are only able to employ in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, ,LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, or WI. title: Lead Applied AI/ML Data Scientist at Dynatron Software
full_text: About Dynatron Dynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that drive measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments. Our analytics, automation, and AI-powered workflows help service leaders improve profitability, increase operational efficiency, and make smarter business decisions. As Dynatron expands its AI capabilities, we’re focused on building intelligence that solves meaningful customer problems—not adding AI for its own sake. That requires exceptional applied data science, rigorous evaluation, strong product judgment, and the ability to turn complex automotive data into capabilities that perform reliably in the real world. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Lead Applied AI/ML Data Scientist to serve as a technical authority for the AI and machine learning capabilities embedded within Dynatron’s SaaS platform. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who has built AI capabilities that reached production, served real customers, and evolved based on what happened after launch. You’ll own modeling approaches across core prediction and classification use cases while helping define how Dynatron evaluates, prioritizes, and develops emerging generative AI capabilities. You’ll work directly with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, and product leadership to translate business problems into technically sound AI solutions. Just as importantly, you’ll help determine which ideas shouldn’t be built: challenging assumptions, identifying limitations, and recommending better approaches when the technology doesn’t support the desired outcome. Proofs of concept aren’t the finish line here. Success means building AI capabilities that create measurable value for customers and perform reliably in production. What You’ll Do Lead Applied Machine Learning Own modeling approaches for Dynatron’s core classification, prediction, and other applied machine learning use cases. Design features and modeling strategies for complex, messy, real-world automotive data. Establish rigorous approaches to class imbalance, validation, experimentation, and model evaluation. Continuously improve models based on production performance, changing data, and customer outcomes. Raise the standard for how applied machine learning is developed, evaluated, documented, and shipped across the organization. Build Production AI Capabilities Design and build AI/ML capabilities from initial problem definition through production release. Translate customer and product problems into appropriate modeling approaches rather than beginning with a predetermined technology. Build solutions that balance model quality, scalability, explainability, latency, cost, and maintainability. Remain engaged after launch to understand real-world performance and improve capabilities based on production evidence. Shape the AI Product Roadmap Serve as a technical authority on the feasibility of proposed AI capabilities. Partner with Product leadership to evaluate opportunities before significant engineering investment is made. Clearly articulate what is technically achievable, what requires additional data or sequencing, and what is unlikely to deliver the intended result. Recommend alternative approaches when AI isn’t the appropriate solution. Help prioritize opportunities based on customer value, technical feasibility, data readiness, and implementation complexity. Build with Generative AI & Agentic Systems Develop production capabilities using LLMs and modern agentic frameworks where they provide meaningful product value. Design retrieval architectures, tool-use patterns, and other approaches for grounding AI systems in Dynatron’s proprietary data. Evaluate and adapt foundation models for domain-specific applications, including fine-tuning where appropriate. Establish appropriate controls around quality, latency, token usage, and cost per interaction. Stay current with emerging AI capabilities while applying disciplined judgment about where they belong in production. Define AI Evaluation Standards Establish rigorous evaluation methodologies for traditional ML and non-deterministic generative AI systems. Define appropriate offline and production metrics for individual use cases. Design evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, reliability, business usefulness, and other relevant quality dimensions. Monitor production performance and use real-world results to guide model improvement. Help establish consistent standards for determining when an AI capability is ready for customers. Partner Through Production Work closely with Engineering and MLOps/DevOps partners to establish production-readiness criteria. Define requirements for deployment, monitoring, retraining, and model lifecycle management. Ensure appropriate handoffs without treating productionization as someone else’s problem. Collaborate across Data Engineering, Product, and Engineering to ensure AI solutions have the data and infrastructure required to perform reliably. What You Bring Applied Data Science & Machine Learning Expertise 10+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a closely related discipline. Deep expertise in traditional machine learning, including classification, feature engineering, class imbalance, and model evaluation. Significant experience working with complex, imperfect real-world datasets rather than exclusively curated research data. Strong understanding of experimental design and how to determine whether a model is actually improving an outcome. Production AI Experience — Critical Demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML capabilities into commercial products used by real customers. Ability to speak specifically about systems you’ve built, their scale, how they performed after release, and what you changed based on production evidence. Experience supporting and improving models throughout their production lifecycle. Strong understanding of the differences between building a successful prototype and operating a successful AI product. Generative AI & LLM Expertise Production experience building with LLMs and agentic frameworks. Experience designing retrieval architectures and grounded AI applications. Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies for non-deterministic systems. Experience managing quality, latency, token consumption, and cost per interaction in production. Experience fine-tuning or otherwise adapting transformer models for domain-specific use cases. Product & Business Judgment Demonstrated experience scoping AI initiatives directly with Product Managers and business stakeholders. Track record of identifying technically weak or commercially impractical AI concepts and influencing stakeholders toward better solutions. Ability to translate business problems into modeling problems—and recognize when the underlying problem doesn’t require AI. Strong customer orientation with curiosity about the business problem behind the requested capability. Technical Skills Expert-level Python and strong SQL skills. Comfortable working directly with large datasets in cloud data warehouse environments. Experience collaborating within modern cloud-based data and ML ecosystems. Strong understanding of the data requirements and dependencies necessary to support production AI. Communication & Technical Leadership Ability to communicate sophisticated AI concepts, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong influence skills and confidence challenging assumptions constructively. Ability to establish technical standards and raise the quality of work without direct people-management authority. Strong documentation habits and commitment to making technical decisions understandable and reproducible. Education Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in another domain involving complex operational records, industry-specific taxonomies, or similarly challenging datasets. Experience with cloud-managed AI/ML services and modern production model lifecycle practices. Experience designing, managing, or governing large-scale expert labeling programs. Experience working with proprietary datasets as a foundation for differentiated AI products. What Success Looks Like Successful Lead Applied AI/ML Data Scientists at Dynatron: Turn difficult customer problems into AI capabilities that perform reliably in production. In this role, you will lead the effort to transform product and organizational data into actionable insights for our Product and Engineering organization, driving alignment and helping senior leadership make high-impact decisions.

You are an exceptional relationship builder, translator, and team advocate. Rather than focusing on hands-on technical execution, your strength lies in your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, influence stakeholders across diverse teams, and translate complex data points into compelling narratives that drive business outcomes.

You impact

  1. Establish deep, trusting partnerships with engineering and product stakeholders as well as cross-functional leadership, acting as the primary strategic bridge between analytical execution and business decision-making.

  4. Maintain stakeholder momentum and manage expectations gracefully during long delivery cycles, keeping partners excited and bought into the long-term analytics vision.
  5. Advocate passionately for the analytics function, leveraging high demand for insights to build compelling cases for expanded support.
  6. Lead, mentor, and protect a lean team of technical analysts, providing the necessary "air cover" for them to focus on deep execution while actively coaching them on communication and influencing skills.

Your Qualifications 

  • Strong experience within the technology industry
  • Extensive knowledge of product operations, business insights, program management, or a related role—ideally within a fast-paced SaaS, product, or engineering organization.
  • A strong background of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Exceptional communication, executive presence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among senior leadership.
  • Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance) and successfully influencing decision-making without direct authority.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical data into simple, actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of incoming requests, establish clear operational triage frameworks, and comfortably manage stakeholder expectations.
  • A solid understanding of how product analytics and reporting structures operate (e.g., data flows, modeling, or visualization tools) to effectively translate technical needs, though hands-on coding/modeling is not required.
  • Deep understanding of modern development methodologies (e.g., Agile, SAFe) and the product lifecycle in a SaaS context.

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

Full-time, part-time or flexible Eligibility : You must be eligible to work in Kenya The role We are looking for an experienced Country Director to lead our work in Kenya. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, you will be responsible for delivering the Raspberry Pi Foundation’s strategy in Kenya, ensuring our programmes reach the educators and young people who stand to benefit most. You will have a strong track record of leading educational programmes in Kenya and will have established relationships across the sector. Lead engagement with senior education stakeholders in Kenya, ensuring the Foundation understands and is influencing the policy environment and is proactively engaging with relevant networks and organisations. A significant track record of leading educational programmes at scale within Kenya. Experience developing and managing high-value strategic partnerships with governments, NGOs, and other mission-aligned organisations. Existing relationships with senior government officials and wider education stakeholders in Kenya. An experienced senior manager and leader with a proven ability to build diverse teams and support them to do great work. Ideally, you will have experience managing remote and geographically dispersed teams. A deep and demonstrable commitment to diversity and inclusion, and experience translating that commitment into programme design, delivery, and evaluation. Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the credibility and presence to represent the Foundation at senior levels externally. title: Senior Systems Analyst at Hudl
full_text: At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more. Ready to join us? Your Role Cloud and software are among the largest investments we make, and every dollar there is one that could also be going toward the product itself or the team building it. Our FinOps practice exists to make sure that spend is understood, accountable, and every dollar is working as efficiently as it can. As a Senior Systems Analyst, you’ll own that picture end to end. You’ll allocate spend back to the services and teams driving it, forecast where it’s headed, and consult teams on best practices to propose changes that maximize efficiency. You’ll be the single, trusted source of truth for product and leadership on the real cost of what we build and what’s on the roadmap to better leverage those dollars we put to work. As a Senior Systems Analyst, you’ll: Forecast and get ahead of cost. You’ll own the models that track, allocate, and predict where our cloud and software spend is going, monitor AWS and the rest of our stack for anomalies, and action them the moment they surface. When something breaks, you won’t just put out the fire, you’ll build the guardrails that keep it from starting again. Turn spend into decisions leadership can act on.
