title: Principal Product Manager, Basketball Products at Genius Sports
full_text: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com The Role - Principal Product Manager, Basketball Products The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to lead our basketball product suite.  As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with leading global basketball leagues and federations (e.g., NBA, WNBA, NCAA, FIBA, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver basketball data and insights to teams, leagues, media, and betting partners around the world. You will own the full basketball product suite — AI-driven/automated eventing, Performance Studio enhancements, Next Generation Stats & insights, and Rich data graphics/visualizations — across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement. This is an opportunity to shape how basketball data and analytics are captured and experienced across the industry defining the modern language of sport.  You will be working at the intersection of computer vision, real-time data collection, and advanced sports analytics. The ideal candidate has strong basketball domain experience and is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a diverse product portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data. What You Will Own: As the Senior Product Manager, Basketball, you will be responsible for a suite of basketball products spanning the full data and analytics value chain: Basketball Events Feeds – Real-time and post-game basketball events feeds used by leagues, broadcasters, and downstream partners. Basketball Statistics Feeds – Core and advanced basketball statistics feeds that power team, player, and league-level analysis. Performance Studio – Driving a roadmap of continual improvements to our player and team performance analytics platform, including new metrics, workflows, and user experience improvements. Next Generation Stats & Visualizations – Development of next-generation basketball statistics, tracking-derived metrics, and data visualizations that differentiate Genius Sports in the market. Job Responsibilities: Build, Maintain, and Grow the Genius Basketball Product Suite Understand customer needs across leagues, teams, media, and betting partners; develop requirements and drive delivery of basketball events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post-launch growth and iteration — for each product in the basketball portfolio. Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for basketball products, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data operations, and business teams to ensure basketball product initiatives are delivered on time and on budget. Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for the basketball portfolio, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners. Balance investment across the basketball product portfolio across three horizons - Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months)), ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation. Define KPIs that drive business results for basketball products, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis. Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to drive efficient, effective go-to-market motions and continuously gather feedback from leagues, teams, and media/betting partners and translate it into product requirements. Stay current on basketball analytics trends, computer vision tracking technology, and competitor offerings to keep the basketball product suite at the forefront of the industry. Position Requirements: 7-10 years of relevant product management experience. Strong basketball domain knowledge/expertise. Product management experience building B2B SaaS or other relevant data feeds/ applications: understanding functional requirements and building for scale. Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes. Experience owning multiple related products or a product portfolio simultaneously, balancing competing priorities across a suite of offerings. Extensive background collaborating with UX design partners to build intuitive, user-first experiences. Strong background in BI and/or analytics required; experience working on data-oriented or sports statistics products preferred. Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership, participating in the sales cycle, and handling sensitive, critical issues. Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs). title: Senior / Staff AI Engineer at Snorkel AI
full_text: About Snorkel At Snorkel, we believe meaningful AI doesn’t start with the model, it starts with the data. We’re on a mission to help enterprises transform expert knowledge into specialized AI at scale. The AI landscape has gone through incredible changes since 2015, when Snorkel started as a research project in the Stanford AI Lab, to the generative AI breakthroughs of today. But one thing has remained constant: the data you use to build AI is the key to achieving differentiation, high performance, and production-ready systems. We work with some of the world’s largest organizations to empower scientists, engineers, financial experts, product creators, journalists, and more to build custom AI with their data faster than ever before. Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler! About The Team Snorkel’s AI Platform organization builds the infrastructure and systems that power AI development at scale - synthetic data generation, evaluation, agentic workflows, simulation environments, LLM infrastructure, and distributed compute. Our platform enables engineering and research teams to rapidly experiment with models and agents, measure their behavior, and turn successful experiments into reliable production systems. We’re a small team operating at the intersection of distributed systems and applied AI, and we’re in the middle of a foundational shift toward agent-first workflows where models interact with tools, environments, data, and other agents over long-running trajectories. The systems we build need to make these inherently non-deterministic workloads observable, reproducible, measurable, and scalable. You will help define how we do that. About The Role We’re looking for AI Engineers who combine strong software and distributed systems fundamentals with experience operating AI systems in production. You’ll build the infrastructure that lets teams create, experiment with, evaluate, and operate LLM and agentic workloads at significant scale - from synthetic data and evaluation pipelines to simulation environments, orchestration systems, and LLM infrastructure. You’ll work on systems where correctness is not defined by a single deterministic output. Instead, you’ll build the infrastructure needed to understand behavior across models, prompts, tools, environments, and multi-step trajectories, and to continuously improve those systems through experimentation and evaluation. title: Principal Product Manager, American Football Products at Genius Sports
full_text: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com The Role - Principal Product Manager, American Football Products The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to lead our American Football product suite.  As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with the leading Football leagues and federations (e.g., NFL, NCAA, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver football data and insights to teams, leagues, media, and betting partners around the world. You will own the full football product suite — AI-driven/automated eventing, Performance Studio enhancements, Next Generation Stats & insights, and Rich data graphics/visualizations — across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement. This is an opportunity to shape how football data and analytics are captured and experienced across the industry defining the modern language of sport.  You will be working at the intersection of computer vision, real-time data collection, and advanced sports analytics. The ideal candidate has strong American Football domain experience and is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a diverse product portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data. What You Will Own: As the Senior Product Manager, American Football, you will be responsible for a suite of football products spanning the full data and analytics value chain: Football Events Feeds – Real-time and post-game football events feeds used by leagues, broadcasters, and downstream partners. Football Statistics Feeds – Core and advanced football statistics feeds that power team, player, and league-level analysis. Performance Studio – Driving a roadmap of continual improvements to our player and team performance analytics platform, including new metrics, workflows, and user experience improvements. Next Generation Stats & Visualizations – Development of next-generation football statistics, tracking-derived metrics, and data visualizations that differentiate Genius Sports in the market. Job Responsibilities: Build, Maintain, and Grow the Genius American Football Product Suite Understand customer needs across leagues, teams, media, and betting partners; develop requirements and drive delivery of football events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post-launch growth and iteration — for each product in the football portfolio. Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for football products, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data operations, and business teams to ensure football product initiatives are delivered on time and on budget. Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for the football portfolio, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners. Balance investment across the football product portfolio across three horizons - Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months)), ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation. Define KPIs that drive business results for football products, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis. Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to drive efficient, effective go-to-market motions and continuously gather feedback from leagues, teams, and media/betting partners and translate it into product requirements. Stay current on football analytics trends, computer vision tracking technology, and competitor offerings to keep the football product suite at the forefront of the industry. Position Requirements: 7-10 years of relevant product management experience. Strong American Football domain knowledge/expertise Product management experience building B2B SaaS or other relevant data feeds/ applications: understanding functional requirements and building for scale. Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes. Experience owning multiple related products or a product portfolio simultaneously, balancing competing priorities across a suite of offerings. Extensive background collaborating with UX design partners to build intuitive, user-first experiences. Strong background in BI and/or analytics required; experience working on data-oriented or sports statistics products preferred. Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership, participating in the sales cycle, and handling sensitive, critical issues. Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs). Proficiency in gathering and transforming product requirements into a practical, prioritized product roadmap. Prior experience as a football statistician, analyst, or a strong passion for football and football analytics is a plus. Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. What Success Looks Like: American Football events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations operate as a coherent, well-sequenced portfolio rather than disconnected efforts. Product decisions are consistently grounded in customer needs and data to drive our Genius revenue streams, with clear KPIs tracked and acted on. Cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data ops, commercial) trust the roadmap and rely on the PM as the source of truth for football product direction. Leagues, teams, and media/betting partners see measurable improvement in the quality, timeliness, and depth of football data and insights. The American Football product suite is recognized internally and externally as a differentiator for Genius Sports in the market. title: Chief Information Security Officer
full_text: Position Summary The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) owns enterprise security strategy, risk management, and compliance for the FAL Group of companies under Fortive (Accruent, Gordian, and ServiceChannel) all of which are SaaS / data platform companies in the Facilities and Asset Lifecycle space. The CISO is accountable for protecting customer data, enabling enterprise sales through compliance readiness, and building a security program that scales with the company’s growth trajectory through operating company specific security strategy and program management aligned with Fortive’s baseline posture and policy, but extended to meet the needs of each individual operating company. This role sits at the intersection of technical security leadership and business strategy. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable running an incident response, presenting risk posture to the executive teams, and walking an enterprise prospect’s security team through the company’s controls during the sales cycle. The successful candidate will also be a seasoned communicator across, upstream to the executive teams and downstream to the business with a clear track record of calibrating communication (written, verbal, and in-person) appropriately to ensure success of the overall security program. Key Responsibilities Security Strategy & Program Leadership Own and continuously evolve the company’s information security strategy, aligned to business objectives. Take existing security in excellence practices, communities, executive constructs, and awareness/culture programs and continue to grow them and integrate them as part of the larger security strategy. Lead and develop a high-performing security organization spanning security operations, vulnerability and threat management, security engineering, governance/risk/compliance (GRC), application security, AI security, and all associated cyber or cyber adjacent incident response. Set and manage the security budget, including build-vs-buy decisions on tooling and managed services. Ensure the team is budgeted appropriately to meet, interact, grow, develop, and build connections in security across the operating companies, Fortive, and the local security communities they serve. Establish security architecture standards across cloud infrastructure, AI, application development, and data platforms. Maintain clear visibility of security posture and strategic programs to the three executive teams, owning cyber considerations for enterprise risk management initiatives, and self-attesting risk assessment initiatives. Chair and lead the Information Security Council (ISC) at each operating company, raising security awareness, calibrating updates, and driving resolution of critical cyber risk through executive collaboration and partnership. Lead audit cycles end-to-end — evidence collection, auditor relationships, remediation tracking, and timely certification renewal, while streamlining these operations to minimize business impact. Maintain a current risk register and ensure control gaps are tracked to closure with assigned owners and deadlines and appropriately lead executive risk management escalations with the information security councils at each operating company. Customer Trust & Revenue Enablement Serve as the executive owner of the security review process for enterprise sales — including security questionnaires, customer audits, and contractual security terms. Partner with Sales and Legal to reduce security-related sales cycle friction, treating security posture as a competitive differentiator rather than a cost center. Represent the company in customer-facing security discussions, including Executive Briefing Center engagements with strategic prospects. Governance & Parent Company Reporting Present security posture, risk trends, and program maturity to the Fortive security team and Fortive CISO on a monthly basis. Serve as a key stakeholder in technical and security diligence processes, including those associated with financing events or M&A. Advise the executive team on emerging threats, regulatory changes, and their business implications. Required Qualifications 10+ years in information security, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (CISO, VP Security, Director of Security or equivalent) at a SaaS or data-intensive company. Demonstrated ownership of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 programs, including direct experience managing audit cycles to successful certification. Experience managing executive stakeholders at multiple lines of business at the same time, and nuanced understanding of conglomerate/operating company model. Experience presenting to boards, executive teams — able to translate technical risk into business terms. Strong working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, and Azure), modern application security practices, and data protection regulations relevant to the company’s markets. Track record of building or scaling a security function, including hiring and developing a team. Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles through customer security reviews and questionnaires. Track record of driving security culture, awareness, trust, and delivering on promises on time with quality across executive teams, and at an employee level. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience leading security at an operating company in a conglomerate/operating company model. Strong track record of maintaining best in class team engagement, retention, growth and development of team and in driving enterprise-wide trust around security. full_text: Canonical has re-imagined hiring. Coaching and mentoring team members to grow and develop skill sets specifically around analytical capabilities and thought leadership, developing training materials and documentation to support team members. Driving and representing the team in the absence of the Head of, acting as a credible and trusted adviser and an inspiring leader. Working closely with company leaders to understand, appreciate and communicate our vision for talent at Canonical. What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a psychology or people based subject. A track record of team leadership in a talent function from the technology or consulting industry, with exceptional project management, to lead roadmap execution and delivery. Deep understanding of talent selection, with a technological mindset to create automation's and products to drive hiring efficiencies. Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data, using either SQL, Python and/or statistical analysis. Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience. Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year for company events. full_text: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. We are hiring a Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer in India to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. title: Software Architect
full_text: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957 Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with a global team. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core: Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. Bonus: Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. About the Team The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. Why Join Us Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. Learn More About Autodesk Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! Salary transparency Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Belonging We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk? Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap. Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit. What we're looking for: Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments. 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title. Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth. Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove. Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop. A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers. About the Team: This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats. You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product. Team Operating Rhythms: As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed. Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team. title: Forward Deployed Engineer at Nash
full_text: Forward Deployed Engineer San Francisco or US Remote About Nash Nash powers logistics infrastructure for major commerce brands including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, plus platforms like Shopify and Toast. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company’s own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
full_text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.

As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads. 

What You Will Do

  • Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
  • Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
  • Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
  • Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
  • Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.

title: Senior Counsel at Pair Team
full_text: About Pair Team Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. full_text: POSITION SUMMARY: The Associate Director, Training & Operational Excellence leads the enterprise training and process improvement functions across the Patient Experience organization, partnering with Program Management, Quality, Patient Coordinator (Inside Sales), Patient Billing, and Call Center Operations to align learning strategy and operational standards with business outcomes. This role owns two connected disciplines: the training function — strategy, team leadership, curriculum design, onboarding, and skill development across internal and BPO teams — and operational excellence — identifying process gaps, driving standardization, and embedding continuous improvement into how the organization learns and operates. Training surfaces where gaps exist; operational excellence ensures the fixes are durable and repeatable. The Associate Director operates with minimal oversight while building cross-functional consensus, combining independent ownership of results with strong collaboration across peer teams and departments. Team Leadership & Execution ● Team Management & Development: Build, manage, and develop a high-performing team of training managers, instructional designers, and associates. Set clear performance expectations, own performance improvement plans and remediation programs, and ensure coaching and feedback translate into measurable behavior change. ● Onboarding: Lead effective induction and orientation programs to ensure new hires are rapidly and thoroughly prepared for their roles and reaching productivity benchmarks on time. ● Executive Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner to executive-level leaders on workforce capability, change management initiatives, and organizational readiness tied to training and process improvement. ● Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Patient Coordinator (Inside Sales), Medical Billing, Patient Experience, and Quality leaders to align training delivery with operational needs and resolve competing priorities. ● BPO Training Oversight: Extend training standards and quality practices to BPO and call center partners supporting Patient Experience, ensuring consistency between internal and outsourced teams. ● Budget & Vendor Ownership: Own the training budget, including LMS and vendor spend; make build-vs-buy recommendations on tools, platforms, and content. Operational Excellence ● Process Assessment & Standardization: Identify operational gaps, inconsistencies, and inefficiencies across Patient Experience through data analysis, workflow review, and cross-functional discovery; own the development and rollout of standardized processes and SOPs. ● Continuous Improvement: Embed a culture of continuous improvement across the organization — partnering with Quality, Program Management, and operations leaders to translate findings into durable process changes, not one-time fixes. ● Change Management: Lead the people side of process and system changes, ensuring training, communication, and adoption plans are in place before go-live and that behavior change is measured post-implementation. ● Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Resolve escalated performance or process gaps in real time, adapting training and operational standards as conditions change. Measurement, Data Analytics & KPIs ● Data-Driven Assessment: Leverage data analytics to track employee performance, measure training ROI, evaluate program effectiveness, and identify process inefficiencies affecting the patient experience. ● KPI Ownership: Own and present the training and operational excellence scorecard to executive leadership — including completion rates, time-to-proficiency, quality assurance scores, sales conversion rates, process compliance, and patient satisfaction — translating data into actionable business insights. ● Root Cause & Corrective Action: Partner with Quality to own root cause analysis for recurring performance gaps, ensuring findings drive both training updates and upstream process corrections. ● Strategic Planning: Own the annual and quarterly training and operational excellence roadmap, tying investment and headcount decisions directly to company OKRs and operational goals. ● Industry Alignment: Stay current on training trends, operational excellence methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), and technological developments in healthcare and regulated service environments. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: ●        12 + years of experience with Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Organizational Development, Communications, or a related field in training, learning & development, or operational excellence roles or 8 + with Master’s degree; including at least 3+  years managing managers or multi-layer teams. ●        Demonstrated experience building and scaling a training function, including hiring and developing training managers and instructional designers. ●        Experience in healthcare, patient services, inside sales, or BPO/contact center environments preferred. ●        Familiarity with instructional design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE) and adult learning principles. ●        Experience driving process improvement, standardization, or operational excellence initiatives; familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or CAPA methodologies a plus. ●        Experience owning a training budget and making vendor or build-vs-buy decisions, including LMS platform selection and management. ●        Track record of defining, tracking, and reporting training effectiveness metrics and KPIs to senior leadership. ●        Working knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to patient-facing operations (e.g., HIPAA). title: Product Manager, Core Integrations & API at CallRail
full_text: The Position CallRail is looking for a Product Manager to join our team that supports our core integrations, public API and webhooks products . This is a build role. You’ll ship net-new integrations with platforms our customers depend on — automotive and healthcare tools, scheduling systems, workflow platforms like Zapier — and you’ll deepen the ones we already have. You’ll also own the shared service and framework those integrations run on, and the developer-facing API and webhook surface that thousands of customers and partners build on top of. The other half of the job is keeping the ecosystem healthy. Integrations break in ways ad campaigns don’t, and you’ll be the person who decides what gets fixed first. That means working shoulder to shoulder with Support, Sales, and Marketing — they hear about problems before dashboards do, they know which integration is blocking a deal, and they need you to tell them what’s coming and when. This role suits a hands-on, technically fluent PM who wants to ship real integrations, cares about customer product experience, and works in an environment where AI is a daily tool rather than a talking point. What You’ll Do Build and deepen integrations Ship net-new core integrations — new verticals like automotive and healthcare, scheduling and workflow platforms, and the partners our roadmap calls for next. Deepen existing integrations past MVP: fill functional gaps, expand data coverage, and make the ones customers already rely on genuinely good. Own the shared service and framework every integration inherits — data sync, authentication, error handling, and retries — and the tooling that makes the next integration cheaper to build than the last. Own the integrations UI and library: how customers discover, connect, configure, and troubleshoot what we’ve built. Own the API and webhooks Own CallRail’s public API and webhooks as a product, not a byproduct: new capabilities, versioning strategy, deprecation paths, and the developer experience around them. Drive parity between our API and webhooks so developers get consistent data and behavior regardless of how they consume it. Own API documentation, the developer dashboard, and the administration and billing experience for API access. Define and monitor the health metrics developers actually feel — latency, error rates, rate-limit behavior, webhook delivery reliability — and act on them. Prioritize and triage Own the integrations bug queue. Triage incoming issues, and make the reliability work that keeps the ecosystem healthy visible and scheduled rather than invisible and endless. Make the call on sequencing net-new work against fixes and migrations, and be able to explain that call to anyone who asks. Close the loop with Support — build the intake path that turns ticket patterns into prioritized work, and give them the answers and workarounds they need in the meantime. Keep Sales and Marketing ahead of the roadmap: what’s shipping, what’s fixed, what’s still broken, and what they can confidently sell and promote. Cross-functional Write clear, actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with real technical context and edge cases identified up front. Lead discovery with customers, developers, and internal teams to validate problems before scoping solutions. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience on launches, enablement, and adoption. Represent core integrations and the API in planning cycles and cross-functional initiatives. What You’ll Need 3-5 years of product management experience , including meaningful time on integrations, APIs, developer tools, or platform-oriented work. Background in marketing tech, communications tools, or call tracking ecosystems. A track record of actually shipping B2B SaaS integrations end to end — not just governing a platform others built on. Strong technical fluency. You read API documentation comfortably, reason about data models and auth flows, understand webhooks and event delivery semantics, and can scope edge cases with engineers without needing a translator. Hands-on experience with public or partner APIs — REST, OAuth, versioning, rate limiting, pagination, and webhook reliability patterns. Demonstrated fluency with AI tools (Claude or similar) in your actual day-to-day product work. Comfort working directly with Support, Sales, and Marketing — turning their signal into prioritized work and keeping them informed without being asked twice. Comfort with the unglamorous half of integration work: bugs, migrations, and reliability — and the judgment to prioritize it against net-new. Ability to prioritize clearly across business goals, customer needs, and technical feasibility, and to explain your reasoning to both engineers and executives. Experience in Agile teams working closely with engineers and designers. Excellent written communication. Integration decisions live or die by how well they’re documented. Familiarity with tools we use: Jira, Confluence, Miro, Looker, Fullstory, Figma. Nice to Have Experience building or scaling a developer platform, API program, or developer portal. Experience with vertical software ecosystems — automotive, healthcare, home services, or legal. Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, or designing APIs intended for AI consumption. Working With AI at CallRail AI is core to how our product team operates, and we expect it to be core to how you operate. We use Claude across discovery, spec writing, data analysis, prototyping, and internal tooling, and we’re actively building AI capabilities into the product itself. In this role you will: Use AI daily as a working tool — clustering support tickets to find the real bug patterns, drafting and pressure-testing specs, exploring API data, and building throwaway scripts and prototypes to answer questions faster than a meeting could. Build your own leverage rather than waiting for it — writing Claude skills, agents, and internal workflows that make you and your team faster. Think about CallRail’s platform as something AI agents will consume, not just humans. MCP servers, agent-friendly API design, and tool-calling patterns are increasingly part of what a modern integrations platform is expected to offer, and you’ll help shape our point of view there. Stay genuinely current. The tooling changes every few months, and we want someone curious enough to keep up and pragmatic enough to know when a new tool actually helps. We’re looking for evidence that you’ve already changed how you work because of these tools — not just enthusiasm about them. If you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience. title: Director, Financial Services - Governance, Risk & Compliance
full_text:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Governance, Risk & Compliance practice are looking for a Director with a strong commercial track record to join the team. 

Baringa is building the world's most trusted consulting firm. We work with everyone from FTSE 100 names to bright new start-ups, in every sector. We have hubs in Europe, the US, Asia and Australia and bring deep industry expertise enabled by advanced technology to help clients deliver with greater confidence and certainty.

Our Financial Services GR&C practice helps leading banking and insurance clients navigate an increasingly complex risk and regulatory environment to proactively manage and future-proof risk and compliance functions so they are streamlined, scalable and fit for the future. We support clients across economic crime, conduct & compliance, operational risk & resilience, data, digital & cyber risk, treasury & liquidity risk and climate risk & sustainability. All underpinned by our AI, data and technology capability.

As the market continues to evolve, we are investing in our Governance, Risk & Compliance capability and are seeking a Director with a strong commercial track record to help shape the next phase of growth.

What you will be doing

  • Lead large-scale risk, regulation and compliance transformation programmes for leading Financial Services organisations.
  • Advise Boards, Board Risk Committees, Executive Committees and senior risk leaders on risk strategy, governance, controls and operating model effectiveness.
  • Help clients design and implement enterprise-wide risk frameworks, governance structures and control environments
  • You will lead complex engagements across operational risk, compliance, conduct risk, regulatory change and broader non-financial risk agendas, or within financial risk – specifically treasury and liquidity
  • Identify and originate new opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts, supporting the continued growth of the practice.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across UK Financial Services organisations.
  • Contribute to the development of Baringa’s propositions, intellectual property and thought leadership.
  • Support the growth of emerging capabilities including AI governance, AI risk management, digital asset risk and compliance frameworks.
  • Coach, mentor and develop consultants and future leaders within the team.
  • You will play an active role in shaping the long-term strategic direction of the Risk practice, with a clear pathway towards equity Partner.

Your skills and experience

You will have significant experience across multiple areas of financial or non-financial risk, including:

Broad Governance, Risk & Compliance Expertise

You will have significant experience across multiple areas of financial or non-financial risk, including:

  • Enterprise Risk Management
  • Risk Governance and Framework Design
  • Operational Risk
  • Compliance and Conduct Risk
  • Regulatory Change
  • Controls Frameworks and Assurance
  • Risk Operating Model Design
  • Risk Transformation Programmes
  • Treasury and liquidity risk

We are particularly interested in individuals who bring broad risk advisory expertise rather than a highly specialised niche focus.

Growth and Emerging Risk Capabilities

You will have experience in one or more of the following strategic growth areas:

  • AI Governance and Risk Management
  • Digital Asset Risk and Compliance frameworks
  • Experience helping clients respond to evolving regulatory expectations and emerging technologies.

Commercial and Client Leadership

  • A proven track record of developing trusted client relationships and growing strategic accounts.
  • Strong commercial instincts and an ability to identify and shape consulting opportunities.
  • Experience leading the origination and expansion of consulting engagements.
  • Credibility with C-suite, Board and senior executive stakeholders.
  • A recognised market profile within UK Financial Services.
  • Demonstrable experience contributing to business development and practice growth.

Financial Services Network

  • Strong relationships across the UK Financial Services market.
  • Experience working with leading banking organisations such as Large Global retail banks and other Tier 1 institutions.
  • The ability to engage executive stakeholders and establish new client conversations.
  • A strong understanding of the strategic, regulatory and risk challenges facing the sector.

Leadership

  • Leading complex transformation programmes and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Developing, coaching and inspiring high-performing consultants.
  • Building propositions and contributing to thought leadership.
  • Acting as a trusted adviser to senior client stakeholders.
  • Supporting succession planning and capability development.
  • Demonstrating the attributes and potential required for future progression to Partner.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

title: Contract: Senior Producer (project manager / delivery manager) at Portable

We’re also using this as a chance to build an ongoing pool of contract producers we can call on when the need arises: covering a capacity gap, supporting a team through a busy patch, or adding delivery leadership at short notice. We’re keen to hear from people who can start immediately or relatively soon, as well as people who’d like to be considered for future opportunities. We use the title “producer” at Portable. If you know this kind of work as project management, delivery management, or delivery leadership, this is the same role: it’s about managing scope, budget, timelines, and the people and partners involved in delivering a project, rather than producing film, video, or animation. The kind of project you join will depend on what’s needed at the time. Portable delivers digital products, large-scale website design and development, strategic design and service design work, AI tool development, and a range of other project types (check out portable.com.au for examples of our work). Then there’s you You’re an experienced producer, project manager, or delivery manager with significant experience behind you: typically 8 or more years delivering technology, design or research projects. You’re comfortable leading delivery independently: picking up a brief, asking the right questions, and getting moving without waiting to be told what to do next. Comfort with feedback, in both directions: you’re open to input from anyone on the team, not just people in your exact role, because you’re as invested in the quality of the work as we are. Significant experience (typically 8 or more years) delivering digital research, design or technology projects, ideally with significant budgets ($500k+). Confident stakeholder communication, and the judgement to know when to escalate. Comfort managing scope, budget and timelines under real time pressure. Experience across agile and waterfall methodologies, and the judgement to know when each is useful. Familiarity with common delivery tools (Jira, Asana and similar), and the flexibility to pick up whatever a new team is already using. Experience delivering projects for government and/or not-for-profits. What this can look like Because this is an ongoing pool rather than one fixed role, the work varies depending on what’s needed at the time. You might be: Leading delivery on one or more projects end to end, keeping scope, budget and timelines on track. Stepping into an existing team partway through a project, and getting up to speed fast. Writing or refining a statement of work, tracking assumptions, risks and dependencies. Running stand-ups, workshops and client check-ins. Coordinating research, design and development inputs so the right work happens at the right time. Providing extra delivery leadership or capacity during a busy period or a gap in the team. Supporting in identifying, scoping and bidding for new business opportunities. Engagement details Engagement length, hours and rate vary depending on what’s needed: anywhere from a short burst of support to a few months of work. We’re especially keen to hear from people who could start immediately or at short notice, though we also want to hear from people available further down the track. Preferably you’d be able to work hybrid from our Melbourne or Adelaide office, but we’re also open to other remote options within Australia. How to apply We’re committed to building a diverse and equitable pool of contractors. People from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply. To be considered, please send us: Your resume. A short cover note answering: What attracted you to this opportunity, and why do you think you’d be a good fit? title: Chief Product Officer at Belong Health
full_text: Hello, we’re Belong. We partner with regional payers to deliver Medicare Advantage and Special Needs Plan products. With a dual focus on data-driven, proactive clinical intervention and unwaveringly empathetic patient experience, Belong has completely reimagined health insurance for seniors and other Medicare-eligible individuals who have been disregarded and deprioritized for far too long. We believe that only by recognizing individuals can we make communities strong. Belong Health. Kinder, more supportive care. Summary Belong Health is hiring a Chief Product Officer to own the company product portfolio and lead its AI and technology development. The role covers both halves of that work: the core health plan systems and platforms Belong has already built and operates for its partners, and the new set of AI capabilities, including agentic systems, that will extend those platforms and change how the work gets done. The Chief Product Officer sets product strategy, owns the roadmap, and works alongside engineering, clinical, operations, and compliance leaders to ship software that runs real Medicare Advantage business. Belong Health partners with regional health plans to launch and scale Medicare Advantage Special Needs Plans, including Dual Eligible (D-SNP) and Chronic Condition (C-SNP) plans, and is venture backed and fully distributed across the United States. With roughly 85 people in the company, this is a hands-on job: the person in it will write specifications, sit in partner meetings, and build a small senior team rather than manage a large organization. Essential job duties and responsibilities Own the product vision for the Belong platform and turn it into a roadmap with clear sequencing, staffing, and delivery dates. Decide where AI changes how the platform works and where it does not, and defend those decisions with evidence rather than enthusiasm. Make build, buy, and partner calls, including decisions about core administrative processing systems and other vendor platforms. Bring a point of view on how Belong packages and prices its platform for health plan partners. Lead the design and delivery of AI capabilities, including agentic systems, across care management, member and provider engagement, utilization management, claims and encounter workflows, and back office operations. Set the standards for model selection, evaluation, monitoring, and human oversight. Every AI capability needs a measurable quality bar before it touches regulated or member-facing work. Work with security and compliance on data governance for protected health information used in AI systems, including vendor review, business associate agreements, and audit trails. Track the outside market closely enough to know what Belong should build, what it should buy, and what it should wait on. Own the existing health plan systems: enrollment, care management, member and provider engagement, quality and Star Ratings reporting, risk adjustment support, and partner analytics. Keep the platform current with CMS requirements and with Model of Care obligations, working with compliance and clinical leadership. Lower the cost to serve each member while holding or improving service levels and audit performance. Run planning, prioritization, and release management across product and engineering. Set and report product metrics, including adoption, cycle time, defect rates, cost to serve, and partner satisfaction. Manage vendor and platform relationships, including contract scope, service levels, and escalation. Serve as the product voice in prospective partner diligence, finalist presentations, and contracting. Translate partner requirements into roadmap decisions without letting the platform fragment into one-off builds. Support board reporting and fundraising with a clear account of what the technology does, what it costs, and what it returns. Supervisory responsibilities Direct reports include product management, design, and technical leads. Hire, coach, and retain product managers, designers, and technical leads. Build a small senior team that produces a large amount of work. Partner with clinical, operations, actuarial, finance, and compliance leaders on shared goals and shared accountability. Contribute to company strategy as a member of the senior leadership team. Required professional experience and qualifications Twelve or more years in product management or product engineering leadership, including five or more years leading a product function at the vice president level or above. Direct experience building software for health plans or risk-bearing provider organizations. Medicare Advantage experience is required. Ownership of an enterprise platform through at least one full build and scale cycle, from concept to production use by paying customers. Hands-on experience delivering machine learning or AI features to production, including at least one agentic or large language model based system operating in a regulated environment. Working knowledge of the CMS requirements that shape plan operations: enrollment, encounter and claims data, Star Ratings, risk adjustment, appeals and grievances, and Model of Care. Experience with HIPAA and protected health information handling, vendor security review, and audit readiness. Record of shipping with a small team and a constrained budget. Preferred professional experience and qualifications Experience at a Series B through Series D company, including work through a period of financial constraint or restructuring. Special Needs Plan experience, particularly D-SNP or C-SNP product design and operations. Familiarity with core administrative processing systems. Experience selling to or serving regional Blue Cross Blue Shield plans or provider-sponsored health plans. Comfortable with ambiguity and willing to make decisions before the data is complete. Direct in communication. Raises problems early and in writing. Credible with clinicians, actuaries, and engineers in the same meeting. Motivated by the outcome for members who are dually eligible or living with chronic conditions. Education, training, license and certification Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degree in a technical, clinical, or business field preferred. This is a remote position based anywhere in the United States, with work performed primarily at a computer workstation. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. title: Technical SEO Specialist at OLX

Keyword and intent universe mapping per category Benchmarking coverage against direct and indirect competitors Identifying landing page pattern gaps (facets, location-intent combos, UGC-driven pages) Scoping scalable content or template solutions for volume coverage Feeding gap findings into the SEO/GEO Lead’s prioritization framework Cannibalization Handling: Diagnose and resolve instances where OLX pages within your categories compete against each other for the same queries - diluting rankings and confusing crawlers. What can you expect from us and what do we offer? A seat inside product teams - real influence on how OLX’s platforms are built and prioritized Exposure to SEO at a scale most practitioners never encounter billions of indexed pages, multi-market, multi-language A clear growth path toward the SEO/GEO Lead level within the General Classifieds structure Comprehensive compensation package with annual performance-based bonus, meal allowance and medical insurance Access to continuous professional development and a global network of SEO and product practitioners. title: Finance & BizOps, Marketing
full_text: TL;DR: Be the strategic finance partner to the Marketing Org. You will own the financial architecture behind every marketing dollar. This is an ownership seat with direct executive visibility, not a reporting function. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. Technical and data-driven : Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure. Service-first partner : You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams. High-slope learner : You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10. Experience : 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required. What You’ll Do Drive marketing efficiency & planning: Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline. Build and own channel-level unit economics: Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go. Connect marketing performance to company outcomes: Work across the organization to ensure marketing investment ties to measurable business results. Analyze market trends, competitive spend, and channel dynamics to inform forward-looking strategy and ensure capital is deployed where it compounds. Support experimentation, reporting, and forecasting: Partner with Marketing to size tests, set success metrics, and forecast impact on growth and unit economics. Create clear, repeatable reporting to track performance, targets, variance, and learnings that translate into action. Accelerate with AI: Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer. You're expected to continuously push what's possible, replacing manual processes with scalable infrastructure that moves at Lovable's speed. A portfolio spanning brand systems and work across multiple digital and physical mediums, anchored by strong, shipped web work. 8+ years of design experience. Meaningful hands-on range across several of these: motion, 3D, illustration, environmental and event design, and interaction. This is a maker's role, and coding is not what we mean by hands-on. Systems-minded: you design components and patterns, not one-offs, and think about how each choice fits a broader system. You've shaped launch moments, events, or brand-partnership surfaces under real deadlines, and you know how to make a moment land. You thrive collaborating with engineers and understand the web as a medium: how layouts behave, what's buildable, how design becomes code. Familiar with Vercel, with working knowledge or experience preferred. Bonus If You: Can prototype or bring ideas to life in code (React / Tailwind / Next.js). You’ll work across the platform, application and infrastructure layers that power Polar - from core infrastructure and observability, to shipping new core primitives that are used within the platform by our customers. In close partnership with the team, you’ll ensure the system scales to handle increasing traffic, architectural complexity and regulatory demands without compromising stability, performance or developer velocity. Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths and design systems that scale with growing traffic and complexity. Experience building or operating distributed systems with strong reliability and operational requirements. title: Solution Lead
full_text: About Summation Summation is building the AI Operator: decision-grade AI systems that help enterprise finance and operations teams turn fragmented data and manual analysis into continuously improving decisions and workflows. Build a detailed understanding of the customer's financial or operational process, decision rights, users, data, constraints, controls, handoffs, and success measures.
